$comment: The CI actions a generated workflow uses, each pinned by its full commit SHA (a tag can be moved; a SHA cannot). Every SHA was read with `git ls-remote https://github.com/<action>.git refs/tags/<version> refs/tags/<version>^{}` on 2026-10-16: all four tags are lightweight, so the SHA shown is the commit. A bump is a change to this file and its re-verification, never an edit of a generated workflow (ADR-001 amendment 8).
